scope: Public env.clipboard read/write through real bounded native helpers; whole stable API, OS/platform and seamless personal migration qualification remain required.

source_cohort.selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; unique existing files, sorted UTF-8 relative paths
source_cohort.digest_algorithm: sha256(concatenate(path UTF-8 + NUL + raw sha256(file bytes)))

items: Frozen original-owner clipboard read/string and write/void contracts validate bounds and well-formed UTF-16 before native dispatch
The existing one-permit native clipboard worker retains real process and pipe occupancy through read/write cancellation and descendant retirement
Actual child helpers, unavailable-backend errors, retired callers and eight FIFO reads preserve native dirty models, history and original disk bytes
Public clipboard and native Ctrl+V share isolated helpers through Unicode CRLF save/Undo/Redo, restart without Node and adjacent integration workflows
Complete native/host regressions, unchanged upstream controls, terminal checks, formatting and strict locked Clippy pass on the recorded final source

retained_failures.finding: Initial real-host tests caught a missing embedded clipboard.cjs; the write-pipe fixture also needed explicit stdin inheritance for a background shell. Both were repaired before final qualification.

New controls reproduced accepted unpaired UTF-16 strings and malformed read receipts. Final admission/framing rejects them before dispatch or slot release. The entire final native/host cohort was rerun after this hardening.

qualification.local: 5/5 named local criteria; no whole stable API row qualified.
qualification.helpers: Real child processes and isolated synthetic helper programs validate the bridge. No personal clipboard contents are accessed.
qualification.platforms: Locally tested on Linux. macOS helper mapping and native Windows backend/actual desktop qualification remain open.
qualification.ci: Preceding 4d69f8d main CI passed Linux and Windows; macOS policy-admission comparison was repaired using the original artifact (31 tests pass). Dedicated Windows capture aborted during VS Code download before targets. Fresh feature-head CI is required.
qualification.release: No release package, tag or publication created for this cohort yet.

remaining: Native Windows clipboard backend and actual OS/display-server qualification
Larger values, arbitrary UTF-16 strings and full runtime behavior
Simultaneous clipboard mutations, helper daemon behavior and wider lifecycle qualification
Remaining environment APIs and the entire stable extension API
Personal extension workflows/proposals, arbitrary visual/configuration fidelity, storage/accounts and cross-platform release qualification
